## Council question

What is kept, discarded and committed after each special battle result?

## Why this needs a ruling

The old JSX allows the traitor winner to discard played cards and commits the leader. Quickstart v0.8 says an ordinary traitor victory allows neither, but treats Break Conditioning differently. Guild Retreat also uses similar wording with explicit exceptions.

## Answer needed

Confirm a consequence table for ordinary traitor victory, successful Break Conditioning and Guild Retreat: troops, spice, leaders killed, leader commitment, cards kept/discarded and battle-winner rewards.

## Provisional drafting approach

Write explicit consequences rather than relying on the phrase "as if by traitor".

This is a research question, not an adopted ruling or a claim that Norbert has answered it. No answer has been supplied yet. Keep the affected rules provisional until Norbert or the council confirms them.

## Sources

Quickstart v0.8, Common Rules Clarifications and Combat Steps; recovered Faq.tsx; [Live Guild](https://dune.zone/factions/spacing-guild).

Part of #1831. Record the confirmed answer, its date and a worked example here before closing. Norbert will share this link with the council; this ticket does not send them a message.
title: Dreamrules ruling: What is kept, discarded and committed after each special battle result?
